cases.description: A materially ambiguous requirement must stop rather than be guessed through.
A bug that cannot be reproduced or grounded must not trigger speculative implementation.
A request too large for one safe tracer-bullet implementation must decompose before coding.
GREEN evidence bound to a stale head or changed acceptance plan must be rejected.
Functionally passing code that violates protected architecture direction must be rejected.
A well-scoped feature with complete exact-head evidence and independent validation should merge.
A stale abandoned execution with no authoritative handoff should recover for safe redispatch.
Concurrent dispatch attempts for one issue must result in one authoritative execution owner.
